name: @pipeworx/mcp-geonet-nz

tools.name: recent_quakes
tools.description: Recent New Zealand earthquakes from GeoNet (official NZ monitoring, GNS Science), filtered by minimum Modified Mercalli Intensity. MMI 3 ≈ widely felt, 5 ≈ damaging; -1 returns all located quakes. Returns magnitude, depth, locality, felt intensity, and coordinates, newest first. Keyless.

min_mmi.description: Minimum Modified Mercalli Intensity, -1 to 8 (default 3). -1 = all quakes, 3 ≈ widely felt, 5 ≈ damaging. Out-of-range values are clamped.

tools.name: get_quake
tools.description: Get detail for a single New Zealand earthquake by its GeoNet publicID — time, magnitude, depth, locality, felt intensity (MMI), location quality, and coordinates. Keyless.

tools.name: volcano_alerts
tools.description: Current Volcanic Alert Levels for all monitored New Zealand volcanoes (Taupo, White Island/Whakaari, Ruapehu, Tongariro, Auckland Volcanic Field, etc.) from GeoNet — official data USGS doesn't cover. NZ scale 0-5: 0 no unrest, 1 minor unrest, 2 moderate/heightened unrest, 3 minor eruption, 4 moderate eruption, 5 major eruption. Includes activity description, hazards, and aviation colour code. Keyless.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-geonet-nz forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the geonet-nz pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
